# DCM Core Institute

> Independent research and data on tokenized capital markets: digital bonds, tokenized treasuries, the EU DLT Pilot Regime, MiCA and DORA. Content is published in French (/fr/, default) and English (/en/). Nothing on this site is investment advice.

## Observatory & data
- [Market observatory (EN)](https://dcmcore.com/en/observatory/): tokenized market monitors and trackers
- [Tokenized markets monitor (EN)](https://dcmcore.com/en/observatory/tokenized-markets.html)
- [Digital bond tracker (EN)](https://dcmcore.com/en/observatory/digital-bond-tracker.html)
- [Suivi des obligations numériques (FR)](https://dcmcore.com/fr/observatory/suivi-obligations-numeriques.html)
- [Data sources & limitations (EN)](https://dcmcore.com/en/data-sources.html): what is verified vs. modelled
- [Methodology (EN)](https://dcmcore.com/en/methodology/) · [Méthodologie (FR)](https://dcmcore.com/fr/methodology/)
